steps: Attach the X axis to the same logical machine as the A axis
Synchronise the programs before transferring the A axis
Detach the A axis from its current logical machine
Check the current logical machine of the x' axis.
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2.
If the x' axis is attached to logical machine 2, use the attach LM command to attach the Part Program Processor to logical machine 1.
Check the part program `m101.pp` is correctly formatted and free of errors.
Create a part program named `m101.pp` in a root hierarchy folder from your configured search hierarchy.
Check the part program `m101.pp` exists in the specified hierarchy folder.
Verify the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4.
Check the splineon and splineoff blocks for correct placement of control points.
Verify the spline type is compatible with the number of control points.
Add at least three control points between splineon and splineoff commands.
Ensure no sync command is used between control points without proper splineoff and splineon.
Check the splineon block for correct tension factor and spline type settings.
Edit the block to ensure only one class 1 preparatory word is used.
Check the block for any additional class 1 preparatory words and remove them.
Verify the block syntax follows the rule of one class 1 preparatory word per block.
Check the logical device assignment for device 5.
Ensure each logical device is assigned to only one joint.
Verify the Device EtherCAT address is unique for each device.
Set the Joint logical device parameter for each joint to the correct logical address.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the OPC UA server is disabled by verifying `opcua.enable` is `false`.
Verify the Master's expected state.
Check the device's operational state.
Restart the system.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the cyclic task configuration for task 1
Check the number of lost cyclic frames and adjust accordingly
Check the drive's reported error register
Upload firmware to device Drive_3 using the `--firmware -l Drive_3 -p <path>` command
Run the firmware tool in automatic mode to upload firmware for mismatched devices
Verify firmware versions after upload to ensure the mismatch is resolved
Restart the fieldbus to transition it to OP after successful firmware upload
Start AMCore with the `-start device` flag to put the fieldbus in PREOP
